legal.placeholder.title: Default template text: legal review needed
legal.placeholder.body: This is the shop template's default text. Before it takes orders, the shop must add its own details and have a lawyer check the text. Until then, these are not the shop's binding terms or policy.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.intro: The Ukrainian version of this policy is binding; this translation is provided for convenience. This policy explains what personal data we receive when you use the online shop {website}, why we need it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how you can control it. We process data under the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection” and, where the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies to us, under it as well.
legal.privacy.section.controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
legal.privacy.section.controller.body:
The controller of your personal data is the seller who runs this shop. Seller: {sellerName}, EDRPOU / RNOKPP code: {sellerTaxId}, address: {sellerAddress}. All the seller details are at the bottom of the page.

For questions about your data, write to {privacyEmail}.
legal.privacy.section.data.title: What data we collect
legal.privacy.section.data.body:
When you place an order: your first and last name, email, phone, the delivery address or the carrier's pickup point you chose, the billing address if it is asked for, the items and total of the order, the delivery and payment method, the payment status and the parcel's tracking number.

When you create an account: your email, your first and last name and phone if you gave them, and a password. We keep the password only as a hash, so nobody can read it.

You enter your card details on the payment service's page. The shop never receives or stores them: after the payment the service only tells us the result and possibly the card type and a masked card number.

For the emails we send you (order confirmation, delivery updates, password reset) we keep the recipient address and the values filled into the email, not the whole text.

Technical data: the cookies described in the Cookie policy, and the server records of requests to the site (IP address, time, page address, browser details) kept by the hosting provider. To protect the site against abuse we briefly count sign-in attempts and some other actions per IP address, email or account. These counters are not stored in the database, and each one stops counting after a day at the latest.

We also receive whatever you write to us yourself in emails or messages.
legal.privacy.section.purposes.title: Why we use data and on what basis
legal.privacy.section.purposes.body:
To conclude and perform the sales contract: to accept and confirm your order, take the payment, hand the parcel to the carrier, tell you how the order is going, and handle a return or a warranty claim. Your account, if you created one, serves the same purpose.

To meet legal requirements: to keep documents and accounting records of sales, payments and refunds for the periods that accounting and tax law set.

To protect the shop and its customers: to prevent fraud, password guessing and abuse. This is our legitimate interest, and we use only the minimum of data for it.

We send no marketing emails, build no advertising profiles and make no automated decisions with legal effects for you. If the shop wants to do any of this, it will first ask for your separate consent.
legal.privacy.section.recipients.title: Who we share data with
legal.privacy.section.recipients.body:
We do not sell your data. We share it only with those we need to fulfil your order or run the site, and only as much as they need.

The carrier: your name, phone and delivery address or pickup point, to deliver the parcel.

The payment service: the amount, the order number and, for some services, the list of items, to take a payment or make a refund. We do not give it your name or email.

The email service: your address and the text of the email, to deliver it.

The hosting provider whose servers run the site and the database, and the service that stores the backups.

Depending on what the shop has connected, these can be Nova Post (delivery), monobank or LiqPay (payments), Resend or Brevo (emails). Payment services and the carrier may also process the data they receive as independent controllers, under their own rules.

We also give data to public authorities when the law requires it.
legal.privacy.section.transfers.title: Transfers abroad
legal.privacy.section.transfers.body:
Some services, email services in particular, may process data on servers outside Ukraine, for example in the EU or the US. We give them only what they need to do their job and choose services that commit to protecting the data properly.

Where data goes to a country without a decision that it protects data adequately, we rely on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission or on other safeguards the law provides. You can get the list of these services and countries, and a copy of those safeguards, by writing to {privacyEmail}.
legal.privacy.section.retention.title: How long we keep data
legal.privacy.section.retention.body:
We keep your account data until you delete the account.

We keep the contact data of an order (name, email, phone, address) as long as we need it for the order, warranty obligations and accounting, but no longer than the period the shop set under the law. After that we anonymise the order: its number, items, amounts and dates stay as an accounting record, and the contact data is deleted.

A cart is kept for 30 days, a sign-in lasts at most 90 days, and the link to an order placed without an account works for 90 days.

We keep the records of sent emails for 30 days, and of emails that could not be delivered for up to 90 days. If an email service reports that an address does not accept mail, we keep that note so we stop writing to it, until you ask us to remove it or to erase your data.

Database backups are kept for a limited time. Erased data disappears from them as old backups are replaced by new ones.
legal.privacy.section.security.title: How we protect data
legal.privacy.section.security.body:
The site works over a secure connection (HTTPS). Passwords are stored only as hashes, and the cart and sign-in cookies cannot be read by the page's scripts. In the back office, customer data is visible only to staff who need it for their work, and the steps of handling a personal-data request (looking up an address, exporting and erasing data) are logged.

No way of sending or storing data is completely safe. If a breach threatens your rights, we will tell you and the competent authority within the time the law sets.
legal.privacy.section.children.title: Children
legal.privacy.section.children.body: The shop is not meant for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us their data, write to {privacyEmail} and we will delete it.
legal.privacy.section.changes.title: Changes to this policy
legal.privacy.section.changes.body: We update this policy when our services or the law change. The current version is always published on this page, with the date of its last update at the top.
legal.privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights and how to use them
legal.privacy.rightsBody:
You have the right to know what data of yours we process and why, to get a copy of it, to have inaccurate data corrected, to ask for erasure or restricted processing, to object to processing based on our legitimate interest, and to receive your data in a format you can take to another service.

Within 10 working days we tell you whether your request will be met, and we meet it within 30 calendar days of receiving it (within one month where GDPR applies). Some data we cannot delete while the law requires us to keep it, for example the accounting records of sales and payments. We then delete or anonymise everything else and explain what was kept and why.

If you believe we infringe your rights, you can complain to the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights and, where GDPR applies to us, to the data protection authority of your EU country.
legal.privacy.selfService: If you have an account, you can download your data or delete the account yourself under {account}. Deleting it needs your password. While an order, payment or delivery is still open, the deletion has to wait.
legal.privacy.guests: If you ordered without an account or want to use another right, write to {privacyEmail} from the address you gave in the order. We may ask you to confirm that the address is yours.
legal.terms.title: Terms of sale
legal.terms.intro: The Ukrainian version of these terms is binding; this translation is provided for convenience. This document is the seller's public offer to conclude a distance sales contract for goods through the online shop {website} on the terms below. By placing an order you accept these terms in full.
legal.terms.section.general.title: General provisions
legal.terms.section.general.body:
This offer is a public contract within the meaning of articles 633 and 641 of the Civil Code of Ukraine: its terms are the same for every buyer, and the buyer accedes to the contract as a whole (article 634). The contract is concluded under the Law of Ukraine “On Electronic Commerce” and consumer protection law.

Seller: {sellerName}, EDRPOU / RNOKPP code: {sellerTaxId}, address: {sellerAddress} (the Seller). The Buyer is the person who places an order on the site.

Under article 642 of the Civil Code of Ukraine, the offer is accepted by placing an order on the site. From that moment the contract is concluded in electronic form.
legal.terms.section.subject.title: Subject of the contract
legal.terms.section.subject.body:
The Seller undertakes to transfer ownership of the goods ordered on the site to the Buyer, and the Buyer undertakes to pay for and accept them on the terms of this offer.

The Seller takes care that the descriptions, photos and specifications on the site are accurate. A colour on screen may differ slightly from the real one depending on the device's settings.
legal.terms.section.ordering.title: Placing an order
legal.terms.section.ordering.body:
The Buyer places the order on the site: adds goods to the cart, gives contact details, chooses the delivery and payment method and confirms the order. An account is not required.

After the order is placed, the site shows its number, and the shop sends an email with the items and total to the address given. The terms of the contract are those of this offer in the version in force when the order was placed.

The Buyer is responsible for the accuracy of the details given. If the Seller cannot fulfil the order, for example because an item is out of stock, the Seller tells the Buyer, and they agree on a replacement or a cancellation. For a cancelled order, everything paid is refunded in full.

The Buyer may cancel the order before it is shipped by telling the Seller.
legal.terms.section.prices.title: Prices
legal.terms.section.prices.body:
Prices on the site are in hryvnias. If the Seller is registered for VAT, prices include VAT.

The price of an item is fixed when the order is placed and does not change afterwards. Delivery is not included in the price of the goods: its cost is shown at checkout or is paid to the carrier at its rates, as the site states.

If a technical error shows a clearly wrong price on the site, the Seller tells the Buyer before shipping. The Buyer may accept the correct price or cancel the order and get back everything paid.
legal.terms.section.payment.title: Payment
legal.terms.section.payment.body:
The Buyer pays for the order by one of the methods shown at checkout. Depending on the shop's settings, this may be an online card payment through a payment service or other methods the Seller offers.

The Buyer enters card details on the payment service's secure page, and the Seller never receives them. An online payment counts as made once the payment service has confirmed it.

The Seller gives the Buyer a payment document as the law requires.

If an order that requires prepayment is not paid, the Seller may cancel it.
legal.terms.section.delivery.title: Delivery
legal.terms.section.delivery.body:
The Seller delivers the goods by the method the Buyer chose at checkout, for example to a Nova Post branch or parcel locker, or another available way. Approximate delivery times and costs are shown on the site.

Once the order has shipped, its tracking number appears on the order page.

On receipt, the Buyer checks the packaging, the quantity and the appearance of the goods in the presence of the carrier's staff. If the parcel is damaged, the Buyer may refuse it and draw up a report with the carrier.

The risk of accidental loss of or damage to the goods passes to the Buyer when the Buyer receives them.
legal.terms.section.returns.title: Returning goods of proper quality
legal.terms.section.returns.body:
A Buyer who is a consumer may withdraw from the purchase of goods of proper quality within 14 days of receiving them without giving a reason, unless consumer protection law sets otherwise.

To return goods, the Buyer tells the Seller at {sellerEmail} or by phone at {sellerPhone}, giving the order number, and sends the goods back in their original condition with the packaging and the proof of purchase if there are any. The Buyer is liable for any loss in value caused by handling the goods beyond what is needed to examine and check them.

The Seller pays the cost of returning the goods.

The Seller refunds the price paid for the goods no later than 14 days after receiving them back, by the same method the Buyer paid with, unless they agree on another method.

Goods that consumer protection law excludes cannot be returned, in particular goods made to the Buyer's specification.
legal.terms.section.quality.title: Faulty goods
legal.terms.section.quality.body:
If the goods are faulty, a Buyer who is a consumer has the rights that consumer protection law gives, in particular to ask for a replacement, a repair, a price reduction or a refund. The warranty period, where there is one, is given in the product description or the documents that come with it.

The Buyer reports a fault to the Seller at {sellerEmail} with the order number and, if possible, photos. The Seller pays for shipping faulty goods and their replacement.
legal.terms.section.liability.title: Liability
legal.terms.section.liability.body:
The parties are liable for breach of the contract under the law of Ukraine. Nothing in this offer limits the rights consumer protection law gives a Buyer who is a consumer.

Neither party is liable for failing to perform because of force majeure certified as the law requires. The party that cannot perform tells the other without delay, and the time for performance is extended for as long as those circumstances last.
legal.terms.section.personalData.title: Personal data
legal.terms.section.personalData.body: How and why the Seller processes the Buyer's personal data is described in the Privacy policy published on the site.
legal.terms.section.disputes.title: Disputes
legal.terms.section.disputes.body:
The parties try to settle disputes by negotiation. The Buyer sends a claim to {sellerEmail}, and the Seller answers it within the time the law sets.

A Buyer who is a consumer may also turn to the State Service of Ukraine on Food Safety and Consumer Protection or to a court under the law of Ukraine.
legal.terms.section.final.title: Other terms
legal.terms.section.final.body:
The contract is governed by the law of Ukraine.

The Seller may change the terms of the offer by publishing a new version on this page. An order is governed by the version in force when it was placed.

The offer is made in Ukrainian. Translations are provided for convenience, and if they differ, the Ukrainian version prevails.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie policy
legal.cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files a site stores in your browser. We set only the cookies the cart and signing in cannot work without and, once you choose one, a cookie for your theme. We use no cookies for analytics or advertising and load no third-party scripts, so we show no consent banner.
legal.cookies.row.cart.when: You add the first item to your cart.
legal.cookies.row.cart.kept: For the cart retention period the shop sets (30 days by default).
legal.cookies.row.session.purpose: Keeps you signed in to your account.
legal.cookies.row.session.when: You sign in or create an account.
legal.cookies.row.session.kept: Until you sign out or the sign-in expires.
legal.cookies.row.theme.purpose: Remembers the theme you chose (light, dark or as on your device). Holds no personal data.
legal.cookies.row.theme.when: You choose a theme at the bottom of the page.
legal.cookies.row.theme.kept: One year, or until you choose another theme.
legal.cookies.staff: Staff who sign in to the shop's back office receive one more session cookie of the same kind. Visitors never receive it.
legal.cookies.section.storage.title: Other browser storage
legal.cookies.section.storage.body:
During checkout we keep a draft of the form in the current browser tab's storage (sessionStorage): the contact details, address and delivery method you typed. That way nothing is lost if you reload the page or switch the language. The draft is not sent anywhere until you confirm the order. It is deleted when the order is placed or you sign out, and a draft older than one hour is not restored but deleted the next time the site reads it.

While you go to the payment service and back, the same storage keeps technical keys of the payment attempt and, for an order without an account, the order number and its access key. Only this tab can read them.

If the shop has turned on its demo notice, the browser keeps only the flag fluxkit_demo_notice_seen in localStorage, recording that you have seen it. It holds no personal data and stays until you clear the site's data.
legal.cookies.section.noTracking.title: Analytics and advertising
legal.cookies.section.noTracking.body: We use no cookies or other technologies for analytics, advertising or tracking you across other sites. If that changes, we will update this page and ask for your consent before setting such cookies.
legal.cookies.section.manage.title: How to control cookies
legal.cookies.section.manage.body: You can view, delete or block cookies in your browser's settings. Without the cart and sign-in cookies the cart is not kept and you cannot sign in. Without the theme cookie the site shows its default theme.
legal.cookies.section.changes.title: Changes to this policy
legal.cookies.section.changes.body: If we start using other cookies, we will update the table on this page and the date of the last update. Send questions about cookies to {privacyEmail}.
